title: Bounded learned state retrieval with cosine reranking
question: Can a learned binary state proposal plus bounded cosine reranking preserve the continuous exhaustive cosine retriever's capability while reducing state-search work?
hypothesis: H_selective_cosine: a learned 8-bit semantic index with radius-2 probing and K=4 cosine reranking will retain most of the exhaustive cosine retriever's target states and downstream capability while scoring at most four states instead of all 64.

arms.name: exhaustive_cosine
arms.intervention: continuous cosine scoring over all M=64 learned state embeddings, followed by exact candidate lookup and execution

arms.name: selective_cosine
arms.intervention: learned 8-bit binary proposal, Hamming radius 2, K=4, cosine reranking over retained states, followed by exact candidate lookup and execution

endpoints.name: state_target_retention
endpoints.role: primary — selective retrieved shortlist contains the same top-level target state selected by the exhaustive cosine arm

endpoints.name: end_to_end_success
endpoints.role: secondary — exact downstream output matches the exhaustive-cosine reference output

endpoints.name: proposal_target_retention
endpoints.role: secondary — learned binary proposal contains the exhaustive target before cosine reranking

decision_rule.condition: selective_cosine actual target-state recall >= exhaustive_cosine actual target-state recall - 0.05 AND selective_cosine actual end-to-end success >= exhaustive_cosine actual end-to-end success - 0.05 AND shortlist size <= 4
decision_rule.licenses: bounded support for a learned selective state retrieval boundary with cosine reranking on this synthetic workload, with capability measured against hidden environment truth
decision_rule.does_not_license: general semantic indexing, universal retrieval guarantees, hardware speedup, or broad C5

decision_rule.condition: either selective actual target-state recall or selective actual end-to-end success is more than 0.05 below its exhaustive-cosine reference, or shortlist exceeds K=4
decision_rule.licenses: the registered selective boundary does not preserve the exhaustive learned-cosine reference sufficiently
decision_rule.does_not_license: that bounded learned retrieval is impossible

held_constant: one deterministic positive view per update
learned index uses 8-bit sign code and Hamming radius 2
same learned weights are used by exhaustive and selective arms
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and learned-state evidence remains frozen
capability endpoints are evaluated against hidden environment truth for both arms; exhaustive cosine is a reference, not a capability oracle
